# santi020k/website

Modern personal portfolio and blog built with Astro, Lumen UI, and Tailwind CSS. Optimized for performance and developer experience.

## Tech Stack
- **Framework**: [Astro 7](https://astro.build)
- **Styling**: [Tailwind CSS 4.0+](https://tailwindcss.com)
- **Components**: Astro components and [`@santi020k/lumen-astro`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@santi020k/lumen-astro)
- **Interactivity**: Lightweight native JavaScript and custom events; no frontend framework runtime
- **Content**: MDX, [Astro Content Collections](https://docs.astro.build/en/guides/content-collections/)
- **Testing**: [Vitest](https://vitest.dev), [Playwright](https://playwright.dev)
- **CI/CD**: GitHub Actions
- **Formatting/Linting**: ESLint (Flat Config), quality hooks, lint-staged

## Project Structure
- `/src/content/`: All content collections (posts, projects, notes, types)
- `/src/pages/`: Dynamic and static routes
- `/src/components/`: Reusable UI components
- `/src/layouts/`: Base layouts for pages and articles
- `/src/utils/`: Business logic and helpers
- `/.github/workflows/`: CI/CD pipelines
- `/quality.yml`: Analyzer policy and Git hook steps

## Key Configs
- `astro.config.ts`: Main framework configuration
- `eslint.config.js`: Flat Config extending `@santi020k/eslint-config-full`
- `package.json`: Dependency and script manifest
- `llms.txt`: This file (for AI agents)
- `/.agent/overview.md`: Index of available AI agent skills and capabilities
- `/docs/theming.md`: Technical guide to the HSL-based dynamic theming system

## AI Agentic Skills
The project includes specialized skills for AI agents in `/.agent/skills/`. These provide deep context on:
- **Core Development**: Creating components, content collections, adding pages.
- **Maintenance**: Testing (Vitest/Playwright), maintenance workflows.
- **Brand & Delivery**: SEO, marketing, accessibility, brand guidelines.
- **Pro Tools**: Advanced UI/UX reasoning (`ui-ux-pro-max`).
Refer to `/.agent/overview.md` for a full list and links.

## Theming & Design System
The project uses a custom HSL-based theming system for dynamic light/dark modes. All colors are derived from a base `--hue` and `--saturation` using CSS variables (`var(--theme-*)`). Avoid hardcoding colors; use these tokens instead. Detailed docs can be found in `/docs/theming.md`.

## Guidelines
- Follow Conventional Commits.
- Ensure 100% accessibility (A11y) for all content.
- Maintain high Lighthouse scores.
- Use `pnpm run dev` for local development.
